name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dumaguete Leg
short_description: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dumaguete Leg is a half-marathon event held in Dumaguete City, Philippines, on September 20, 2026.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dumaguete Leg is a race organized by RUNRIO Inc. (MILO Marathon), scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026, in Dumaguete City, Philippines. It offers multiple distance options including 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and a 21.1km half-marathon as the primary distance. Registration status for this event is not yet confirmed as open.
pros: Multiple distance options (1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, 21.1km) accommodate a range of runner abilities

research_highlights: The 2026 Dumaguete leg is one of 15 races in the 50th-anniversary MILO Marathon series, scheduled for September 20, 2026, per the official calendar reported by Philstar.
The event offers 3K, 5K, 10K and 21K distance categories, according to the Takbo.ph Philippine race calendar listing.

Local schools and youth categories are a big part of the Dumaguete leg -- past editions gave a 'biggest school delegation' award and included a cheer-dance competition among school groups (2025 edition).
Registration for the Dumaguete leg has previously been handled both online via RaceRoster and through onsite registration at a city park, coordinated with local city hall officials.
The race has strong local government backing -- the Dumaguete City mayor and city officials have personally attended awarding ceremonies in past editions.
research_watchouts: In the 2025 Dumaguete leg, a runner spreading her arms near the finish line caused a collision with another participant behind her, leading organizers to nullify her result -- a reminder to be cautious of crowding right at the finish chute.

Organizers acknowledged gaps in real-time oversight after the 2025 incident, stating they would work on enhancing their 'current race monitoring system' to resolve such issues faster, per their public statement.

At least one participant reported disappointment that official MILO channels did not post podium photos/results for her category after the 2025 race, so don't assume all results will be publicized promptly.

faqs.answer: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dumaguete Leg is scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026. It will be held in Dumaguete City, Philippines. This date marks the specific leg of the broader MILO Marathon series held in this particular city.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: This race offers a range of distances to accommodate different runner levels, including 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and 21.1km. The 21.1km half-marathon distance is designated as the primary distance for this particular event in Dumaguete City.

faqs.question: Who organizes the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dumaguete Leg?
faqs.answer: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dumaguete Leg is organized by RUNRIO Inc., the organization behind the broader MILO Marathon series held across various locations. This particular event takes place in Dumaguete City, Philippines, as one leg of the national marathon series.

faqs.answer: According to available information, the registration status for the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dumaguete Leg has not yet been confirmed as open. Prospective participants should check back for updates regarding when registration will become available for this Dumaguete City event.
